message.content: Hunting for a controller breach — starting with extreme valve tests.
Immediate overflow detected — now shrinking to the minimal failing case.
Shrunk to a compact overflow — now replaying to confirm it.
Confirmed reproducible — inspecting the steps leading into the failure.
Level exceeded capacity with the valve saturated — checking prior states to trace the buildup.
Ledger: open - inflow overwhelms max outflow causing late spill; ruled out none yet. Inspecting earlier buildup.
Level is climbing toward capacity despite full valve — verifying the starting state and testing a counterfactual fix.
My hypothesis is inflow overwhelms max drain — running a lower-inflow counterfactual to prove it.
